source_quality.text_layer: usable prose; formula glyphs lost to legacy encoding and recovered from the page rasters

task_reconstruction: Prioritize the 17 SDGs and plan their ten-year development, including the effect of a shock such as COVID-19.

section_map.summary: summary: three models, the indonesia result, the shock, the robustness verdict
introduction: background, five tasks, literature, our work
priority model: entropy weights and TOPSIS
shock adjustment and the company transfer
appendix: indonesia and turkey centrality tables

contributions.summary: a signed goal graph that keeps synergy and trade-off apart
a priority score from six centralities with no subjective weights
a resource allocation that serves the top goal first and promotes a finished goal

assumptions.summary: the source data are authentic, because studying fake data is meaningless
all seventeen goals are equally hard to finish, because difficulty is unmeasurable and no data exists
the correlation efficiency equals 5, by appeal to Pareto's principle

data_and_preprocessing.summary: 95 series, Turkey, Mexico and Indonesia, 2003-2018, balancing years against coverage
linear-regression imputation with a zero floor, then two direction-specific min-max rescalings

models.summary: data preparation: regression imputation and two normalizations, equations (1)-(3)
relationship graph: spearman edges, signed weights, six centralities, equations (4)-(10)
priority model: entropy weights and TOPSIS, equations (11)-(24)
champagne tower: priority allocation with spillover and a shock rewrite, equations (25)-(33)

verification.summary: the ten-year run beats the current plan by four points
two regressions defend the resource estimate
one-way sweeps of C and D give maximum swings 0.041 and 0.028

results_trace.summary: goal 3 and goal 4 rank in the top five for every country
indonesia finishes five goals and gains 13 points by 2033
the shock drops indonesia to three goals and 78 percent

writing_logic.summary: the summary announces three models, then one result, then the shock, then the robustness verdict
each task is reduced to a single key-to-this-problem sentence
every result block ends with an advice block addressed to the decision maker

language_observations.summary: models are proposed by bare name: we propose Relationship Graph Model
a coefficient is defended by two comparatives: better at, and less sensible to
the allocation model is motivated by an everyday scene before any equation
the single weakness is stated as a chain: not readily available, so difficult to estimate

visualization_observations.summary: figure 2: three country graphs, red positive, blue negative, thickness for strength
figure 5: three-panel radar of the normalized priority scores
figure 8: model forecast in orange against a linear regression in blue
figure 11: sensitivity sweeps with the chosen value marked by crossing dotted lines

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: a judge reading for a usable plan gets one named ranking, one ten-year forecast and one shock comparison
the robustness claim rests on two small ranges and is stated in the summary, where a judge looks first

weaknesses.summary: equation (8) uses one symbol for two different counts
equations (22) and (23) mix the standardized ideal with the raw index
equation (31) disagrees with equation (27) by one time step
three goals lose completion while the prose reports an overall gain
78 percent names both the current plan and the shock outcome
the threat coefficient and the mitigation level have no printed values
the shock parameters come from expert data that is not readily available

independent_extensions.summary: a proposed eighteenth goal, international cooperation, so a finished goal's spillover can cross borders

unresolved_questions: why equation (8) uses one symbol for both path counts
why the cardinality operator is written crad
why equations (22) and (23) subtract the raw index from the standardized ideal
why equation (31) shifts the queue index against equation (27)
why 78 percent names both the current plan and the shock outcome
why goals 7, 11 and 12 lose completion while the prose reports a gain
why an edge is dropped below ten connections
why the threat coefficient and the mitigation level have no values
